---
title: "Sprott H System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& y+z^2\\
\dot{y} &=& -x+ay\\
\dot{z} &=& x-z
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=0.5$ and initial condition $(1,-2,1)$.
